intakeSourceUnion.SELF_CREATED: task_origin is NEW_PLATFORM; source_system, source_business_no and business_event_id are null
intakeSourceUnion.ITR: task_origin is NEW_PLATFORM; normalized source_system and source_business_no are present; business_event_id is null
intakeSourceUnion.PROJECT_EVENT: task_origin is NEW_PLATFORM; normalized business_event_id is present; source_system and source_business_no are null
intakeSourceUnion.LEGACY_FORWARD: task_origin is LEGACY_FORWARD; source_system, source_business_no and business_event_id are null

originUnion.NEW_PLATFORM: legacy_task_id, legacy_cutover_type_raw, legacy_network_mode_raw, legacy_status_value, legacy_source_version and legacy_mapping_version are null; all required new-platform facts are present; current_stage is P2, P3 or P4; task_status is not LEGACY_UNKNOWN
originUnion.LEGACY_FORWARD: legacy_task_id, legacy_cutover_type_raw, legacy_status_value, legacy_source_version and legacy_mapping_version are present; intake_source_type is LEGACY_FORWARD; task_status is LEGACY_UNKNOWN; previous_task_id, background, cutover_type, network_mode, owner_user_id, customer_id, current_stage, implementation_readiness_snapshot_id, implementation_readiness_snapshot_version, project_scope_version, project_context_snapshot, device_scope_watermark, customer_context_snapshot, readiness_context_snapshot, manual_grade and current_assessment_id are all null; legacy_network_mode_raw may be null; no business command is allowed

cut_task.previousTaskChain: previous_task_id is null for the first task in a business chain; otherwise it points to one same-tenant, same-project, nondeleted direct predecessor whose task lifecycle has been authoritatively ended by the owning later Feature; the relation is immutable, UNIQUE(tenant_id, previous_task_id) forbids sibling successors, and F-CUT-002 itself creates only initial tasks because it does not own a task-ending transition
checks: intake_source_type IN intakeSourceType and satisfies intakeSourceUnion
current_stage IS NULL OR current_stage IN ('P2','P3','P4')
manual_grade IS NULL OR manual_grade IN manualGrade
previous_task_id IS NULL OR previous_task_id <> id
task_origin and legacy fields satisfy originUnion
active_marker is 1 for every active NEW_PLATFORM task device and may become null only when a later Feature ends that task
cut_task_device_scope.legacyRule: LEGACY_FORWARD tasks create no device-scope rows because pms_cut_task has no stable device identity or assignment version
cut_task_device_scope.activeUniquePolicy: NEW_PLATFORM active rows use UNIQUE(tenant_id, project_id, device_id, active_marker)

checks: P1_ACCEPTED requires P1 -> P2 and to_status GRADE_CONFIRMING
P2_ASSESSMENT_SUBMITTED requires P2 -> P3/SURVEYING for A/B/C or P2 -> P4/PLAN_DRAFTING for D
P2_ASSESSMENT_INVALIDATED requires P3 or P4 -> P2 and to_status GRADE_CONFIRMING
cut_task_stage_history.immutability: insert-only; no update, soft delete or synthesized history
cut_task_stage_history.legacyRule: never synthesize P1-P6 history from pms_cut_task.status or timestamps

answerSnapshotContract.submittedRule: SUBMITTED and INVALIDATED snapshots require all four values nonnull

contextSnapshotContract.project: projectId + projectScopeVersion + normalized project/office display snapshot
contextSnapshotContract.devices: non-empty stable deviceId/projectAssignmentVersion vector sorted by deviceId
contextSnapshotContract.implementationReadiness: DRAFT may carry structured READY or NOT_READY snapshotId/snapshotVersion/source watermark/unmetCodes consumed from ImplementationReadinessApi; SUBMITTED and INVALIDATED require READY with empty unmetCodes
contextSnapshotContract.customerServiceLevel: AVAILABLE carries serviceLevelRevisionId/serviceLevelCode/factVersion/effective interval; NOT_CONFIGURED carries customer identity and factVersion with revision/code/effective interval null; both are consumed from CustomerServiceLevelFactApi and no user-entered substitute is allowed

cut_assessment.questionnaireIdentity: CUT Owner constant questionnaireTemplateCode CUT_P2_MANUAL_ASSESSMENT and questionnaireTemplateVersion 1; its exact four questions are this Feature contract, are assigned by the server on first draft creation and are never accepted from the client

statusUnion.DRAFT: manual_grade may be null or A/B/C/D; submitted_by, submitted_at, invalidated_by, invalidated_at and invalidation_reason are null; simple_flow is false until submission; context implementationReadiness may be READY or NOT_READY
statusUnion.SUBMITTED: manual_grade, submitted_by and submitted_at are present; context implementationReadiness is READY and customerServiceLevel is AVAILABLE; simple_flow is true only for manual_grade D; invalidation fields are null
statusUnion.INVALIDATED: the previously SUBMITTED answer/context/grade fields remain unchanged and therefore retain READY/AVAILABLE context; invalidated_by, invalidated_at and normalized invalidation_reason are filled once; current_marker is null; the same transaction inserts exactly one next-version DRAFT with refreshed server-owned template/context, which may contain structured NOT_READY, and current_marker=1, then repoints cut_task.current_assessment_id to that replacement

checks: assessment_status IN assessmentStatus and satisfies statusUnion
manual_grade IS NULL OR manual_grade IN manualGrade
current_marker is 1 only for the task current assessment and is otherwise null
cut_assessment.immutability: DRAFT may be updated only by optimistic version; after SUBMITTED answer_snapshot, context_snapshot, template identity and manual_grade are immutable; INVALIDATED only fills invalidation metadata once and never rewrites the invalidated row when creating its replacement
cut_assessment.invalidationCommandBoundary: a later CUT continuation command that proves a stored submitted context stale invokes the CUT Owner invalidation transition in its write transaction: invalidate the old current row, insert the next-version DRAFT, reset cut_task manual_grade to null and stage/status to P2/GRADE_CONFIRMING, repoint current_assessment_id, increment task version and append P2_ASSESSMENT_INVALIDATED history; no GET or external Provider performs this write
cut_assessment.legacyRule: pms_cut_risk and pms_cut_task.risk_level never create questionnaire answers, an assessment revision or a manual grade

crossTableInvariants: cut_task.current_assessment_id is null before the first draft and otherwise points to the same tenant/task current_marker=1 assessment; invalidation atomically replaces the marker before commit so no committed state has a dangling current_assessment_id
cut_task.manual_grade is null until a current SUBMITTED assessment exists and then equals that assessment manual_grade
every NEW_PLATFORM task has at least one active cut_task_device_scope row and one P1_ACCEPTED stage history row in the create transaction
P2 submission atomically marks the current assessment SUBMITTED, updates cut_task grade/stage/status/version and appends one stage history row
submitted-context invalidation atomically replaces the assessment, resets the task to P2/GRADE_CONFIRMING with null manual_grade and appends one invalidation history row
provider failure, stale context, activity uniqueness conflict or optimistic version conflict leaves all four tables and platform success facts unchanged

qualificationOrder: lock and read one source row by tenant_id and id without changing the legacy row
deleted=b'1' => RETAIN_LEGACY_DELETED and create no target row

require positive id, tenant_id and project_id; normalized code length 1..64; normalized name length 1..128; nonnegative version; nonnull creator/updater each length 0..64; valid create_time and update_time

resolve project_id to the same trusted tenant through the PROJ Owner; deterministic missing/cross-tenant/mismatch => OWNER_FACT_MISMATCH issue and no target row; transient Provider/transaction unavailable => roll the whole claimed batch back to STAGED_READY without a final issue

require normalized legacy cutover_type length 1..32 and legacy network_mode null or normalized length 1..32; preserve both only as legacy raw fields and never validate them against or write them into the F-CUT-001 dictionaries
require legacy status in 0..8; any other value is SOURCE_DATA_INVALID and creates no target row
preflight target uniqueness by tenant_id+project_id+task_no and tenant_id+legacy_task_id before insert

fieldMappings.rule: direct positive Long; target id remains a new CUT Owner identity
direct only after same-tenant PROJ resolution
trim; reject blank or length greater than 64; never generate a replacement code
trim; reject blank or length greater than 128
trim and preserve 1..32 raw characters; current cutover_type remains null
null or trim and preserve 1..32 raw characters; current network_mode remains null
always LEGACY_UNKNOWN; no legacy value maps to GRADE_CONFIRMING, SURVEYING or PLAN_DRAFTING
preserve nonnegative value; target optimistic-lock version starts at 0
initial target optimistic-lock version; never copied from the legacy version

forbiddenMappings: legacy cutover_type/network_mode never populate the current F-CUT-001 dictionary fields
source_type/source_id never prove the new trusted source identity
approval_opinion and remark never become questionnaire answers, readiness facts or stage history
no customer, device, owner, IMP readiness snapshot, project scope version, assessment or stage history is inferred from defaults, test seeds, names or timestamps

legacyStatusPolicy.commandPolicy: LEGACY_FORWARD rows return no allowedActions and cannot be continued, assessed, corrected, deleted or used as an active-device blocker in the new F-CUT-002 path

dispositions.MIGRATED_LEGACY_READ_ONLY: insert one LEGACY_FORWARD cut_task identity projection and retain the source row unchanged
dispositions.RETAIN_LEGACY_DELETED: retain the soft-deleted source row only and create no target row
dispositions.SOURCE_DATA_INVALID: retain the source row, create deterministic migration issue evidence and create no target row
dispositions.OWNER_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE: roll back the caller-owned reconciliation transaction to STAGED_READY and retry the same intent; append no final mapping or issue classification
dispositions.OWNER_FACT_MISMATCH: retain the source row, append a deterministic reconciliation issue in the current transaction and create no target row
dispositions.TARGET_IDENTITY_CONFLICT: retain the source row, record a permanent reconciliation issue and never overwrite an existing target row

migration.batchLifecycle: claim one STAGED_READY PLT migration batch inside a caller-owned transaction; claim, CUT target inserts, PLT mapping/issue appends and completeReconciliation join that transaction; any transient Provider or write failure rolls the batch back to STAGED_READY, while successful classification and count reconciliation move it once to COMPLETED
migration.atomicity: the claimed batch, all classified source rows, CUT target inserts, PLT mapping/issues and final counts commit or roll back together; pms_cut_task is never updated, deleted or dual-written
migration.evidenceOwner: all source identity, target mapping and issue outcomes are written through PLT PlatformMigrationEvidenceApi; CUT never writes PLT tables directly
migration.implementationGate: use the actual next free Flyway version only after this contract passes review; migration tests must cover each disposition and prove legacy rows cannot enter a writable F-CUT-002 state
